name: Home, repos & profiles
tagline: Home summary, your repos and profile pages
summary: A home page that sums up what needs you, a Repositories hub listing every repository you can reach, and profile pages with contributions, pinned repositories and activity.

flow.label: Overview page
flow.note: / greets the viewer with one sentence that links into Reviews, Pull requests and Issues.

flow.label: Repositories page
flow.note: /repos keeps search, visibility, sort and page in the URL and asks the server for that slice.

flow.label: getReposHub
flow.note: Lists every repository, applies the access filter, search, visibility and sort, returns the top N.

flow.label: GitHub REST
flow.note: Repositories of the signed-in user, 100 per page, read until the list ends.

flow.label: RepositoryRow
flow.note: Name, description, language, stars, forks and a commit sparkline loaded near the viewport.

flow.label: Profile page
flow.note: /$owner shows a contribution banner, profile details, pinned repos, activity or a repositories tab.

features.name: Overview summary
features.summary: 'Welcome back' plus one sentence counting reviews waiting, your open pull requests, drafts and assigned issues, then your 10 latest pull requests.

features.name: Repositories hub
features.summary: Every repository you can access, with search, a public/private filter, four sort orders and 'Load more' in steps of 30.

features.name: Repository row
features.summary: Language dot, star and fork counts, and a year of weekly commits as a sparkline that only loads when the row scrolls near.

features.name: Contribution banner
features.summary: The contribution calendar fills the profile banner. Cells are sized to fit the area exactly and fade out toward the edges.

features.name: Activity feed
features.summary: GitHub events grouped by month: one line per pull request in its latest state, and a month's pushes folded into one expandable commits line.

features.name: Pinned and repositories tab
features.summary: Pinned repositories as cards, and a Repositories tab (?tab=repositories). Your own profile lists what the App can see; others list public repos.
